authority.rule: Accepted brief clause 8.1 requires, at minimum, single-instrument calculations to use the same canonical subject/instrument identity across all required inputs; clause 17 requires failure on missing subject matching.

finding: The first NVDA/AAPL witness was repaired only when InputSelectionPolicyVersion.join_keys contains 'subject_instrument'. The public seam still permits a single-instrument policy whose join_keys omit subject_instrument. With join_keys=('contract_id',), an NVDA D011 request using AAPL R034/R035 bindings and AAPL projected observations materialised successfully as an NVDA occurrence with result 101 and AAPL raw lineage. Therefore the minimum single-instrument subject invariant remains configuration-optional and the accepted selection law is not yet enforced fail-closed.

independent_evidence.note: Review stopped at the first failed semantic invariant after confirming the prior witness repair.

repair_proposition: Close the Stage-1 subject-selection class, not only this witness: for every single-instrument calculation, canonical request/binding/projected-input subject identity must be mandatory and cannot be disabled by omitting subject_instrument from a supplied selection policy. Authority-derived proof must discriminate adverse policy configurations as well as mismatched bindings/returned projections. Repair only the Stage-1 selection path required to make that class-level proposition true. Do not start Stage 2.
